items.name: Channellock
items.what: Channellock forges and finishes all its pliers, like the tongue and groove, slip joint, linesman, cutters, and the Ironworker 350S, at its two plants in Meadville, Pennsylvania. The workers there belong to United Steelworkers Local 1917, and the forging dies are made by International Association of Machinists toolmakers at the same site.
items.caveats: This only covers pliers made in Meadville. Channellock branded screwdrivers, ratchet wrenches, and some tool sets come from Canada, Taiwan, or China instead. The Steelworkers contract was ratified in April 2025 and runs three years.

items.name: Snap-on Tools
items.what: Snap-on's hand tools made in Milwaukee, Wisconsin are union made. That plant produces sockets, extension bars, pliers, and screwdriver blades and bits, and the workers there are Teamsters Local 200, confirmed by the local's own 2020 statement.
items.union: Teamsters (Milwaukee, WI); UAW (Elizabethton, TN); Labor 411 lists IBEW/UAW
items.caveats: A claim that the Elizabethton, Tennessee plant is represented by the United Auto Workers could not be backed up. A 1999 labor board case doesn't prove current representation, so treat that plant as unconfirmed. Snap-on runs about nine other US plants and none of them have documented union status. Some Snap-on branded items, like power tools, storage, and the Blue-Point line, are imported.

items.name: Klein Tools
items.what: Klein makes its pliers, wire strippers, and screwdrivers in the US, with forging and heat treating in Mansfield, Texas, a forge in Moran, Kansas, and a plant in Fort Smith, Arkansas.
items.caveats: The union claim rests only on listings that tag Klein as International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers made, and those listings look unreliable elsewhere. Klein's actual ties to the electrical workers union look like training partnerships, not a labor contract, and no union local or contract could be found for the Texas or Kansas plants. Klein moved production to Mansfield after closing its Chicago area plants around 2011, and it's likely these plants are non union. Some Klein products, like testers and meters, are imported.

items.name: Wright Tool
items.what: Wright forges its wrenches, sockets, and ratchets in Barberton, Ohio, and the company says over ninety nine percent of Wright branded products are made in the US. A 1988 appeals court case shows the bargaining unit was represented by Boilermakers Local Lodge 1055.
items.caveats: That Boilermakers link comes from 1980s litigation, so it's worth confirming the local and contract are still current. A separate listing tags Wright as electrical workers made, which conflicts with the court record, so trust the Boilermakers reference over that.

items.name: Stanley (tape measures, New Britain CT)
items.what: Stanley and Stanley FatMax tape measures were made at the Myrtle Street plant in New Britain, Connecticut, turning out about thirty million a year, by members of the Machinists union.
items.caveats: Stanley announced it was closing this plant in February 2026, cutting about three hundred jobs represented by Machinists Local 1433, and the plant wound down and closed in 2026. Stanley says single sided tape production is being discontinued rather than moved elsewhere. Any tapes still on shelves were likely made before the closure, but new production is not coming from a US union plant. Other Stanley, DeWalt, and Black and Decker tape lines are imported or made at non union US plants.

items.name: RIDGID (Ridge Tool Co.)
items.what: RIDGID pipe wrenches, threaders, and tubing tools are made at Ridge Tool Company in Elyria, Ohio, owned by Emerson.
items.union: Labor 411 lists IBT (Teamsters); NW Labor Press (2006) says Boilermakers
items.caveats: Sources disagree on which union represents the plant, with one crediting the Teamsters and another the Boilermakers, and no recent contract news turned up either way. RIDGID branded power tools and shop vacs sold at Home Depot come from separate licensees, mostly imported, and aren't covered by this entry.

items.name: Eklind Tool Co.
items.what: Eklind makes its hex keys, fold up sets, and T handles in Franklin Park, Illinois.
items.caveats: The only union claim, that the plant is represented by the electrical workers union, comes from a single source and couldn't be confirmed independently.

items.name: Wilde Tool
items.what: Wilde makes pliers, pry bars, punches, chisels, and private label tools in Hiawatha, Kansas.
items.caveats: The union claim, electrical workers, comes from a single source and the company's own site doesn't mention union status. Wilde also makes private label tools for other brands.

items.name: Moody Tools
items.what: Moody makes its precision and jewelers' screwdriver sets in Warwick, Rhode Island.
items.caveats: The union claim comes from a single source only.

items.name: Hardcore Hammers
items.what: Hardcore makes its framing hammers and hatchets in Kansas.
items.caveats: This is a small maker, and the union claim comes from a single source only.

items.name: SK Professional Tools (S-K Hand Tool)
items.what: SK sockets, ratchets, and wrenches are made in Sycamore, Illinois.
items.caveats: Ideal Industries sold this brand to GreatStar Tools USA in October 2021, and it's not confirmed whether the plant is still union after that sale. Some SK items are now imported, so check the country of origin marking.

items.name: Stiletto Tools
items.what: Stiletto titanium framing hammers are made in the US.
items.caveats: Stiletto is owned by TTI, the same parent company as Milwaukee Tool, and the union claim may not reflect how things are made today. Check the country of origin on the specific hammer.

items.name: Park Tool
items.what: Park Tool bicycle tools and repair stands are made in St. Paul, Minnesota.
items.caveats: The union claim comes from a single source and couldn't be confirmed. Many Park Tool items are imported, so check the origin.

items.name: Estwing
items.what: Estwing makes its one piece forged hammers, pry bars, and hatchets in Rockford, Illinois. An employee mentioned online in December 2021 that the plant is a union shop.
items.caveats: That's the only evidence either way. No union website, contract news, or labor board record names the union at this plant, and it doesn't show up on the usual union made lists. Treat this one as unconfirmed until something more solid turns up.

items.name: Wheatland Tube (Zekelman Industries) - electrical conduit & pipe
items.what: Wheatland Tube, part of Zekelman Industries, makes electrical conduit and steel pipe at plants in Sharon, Pennsylvania, where about four hundred workers belong to United Steelworkers Local 1660, and in Wheatland, Pennsylvania. Sprinkler pipe comes from Warren, Ohio, where about one hundred forty workers in United Steelworkers Local 9306 ratified a contract in November 2024.
items.union: USW Local 1660 (Sharon, PA); USW Local 9306 (Warren, OH)
items.caveats: Zekelman also runs a Wheatland conduit plant in Chicago and the Western Tube plant in Long Beach, California, but the union status of those two isn't confirmed here.

items.name: Eaton B-Line (strut, cable tray, fasteners)
items.subcategory: Electrical support systems / strut, cable tray, hangers
items.what: Eaton B-Line channel strut, cable tray, conduit hangers, and fasteners are made at Eaton's plants in Highland and Troy, Illinois, by about four hundred workers in Machinists Local 660, who went on strike in October 2024.
items.caveats: This covers the Highland and Troy output only. Eaton makes B-Line and other electrical products at many other plants, both non union and overseas. The outcome of the October 2024 strike isn't confirmed here.

items.name: Prysmian / General Cable (Marshall, TX)
items.what: Power line and telecommunications cable is made at the former General Cable plant near Marshall, in Scottsville, Harrison County, Texas, where about two hundred workers belong to United Auto Workers Local 3057. The union was recertified by a vote of 198 to 66 in a 2021 labor board election after a strike.
items.caveats: Only this Marshall, Texas plant is documented here. Prysmian runs about twenty five other plants in North America, including the former Encore Wire plant in McKinney, Texas, which has historically been non union. Cable products rarely show which plant they came from on the packaging.

items.name: Okonite (Santa Maria, CA)
items.what: Okonite makes Okoguard EPR insulated power and control cable at its plant in Santa Maria, California, where about one hundred sixty workers in Teamsters Local 986 went on strike over wages in May 2025.
items.caveats: Okonite is employee owned and also runs plants in Orangeburg, South Carolina, Richmond, Kentucky, Cumberland, Rhode Island, and Paterson, New Jersey, but the union status of those isn't confirmed. This cable is sold through electrical distributors, not retail stores.

items.name: Louisville Ladder
items.what: Fiberglass and aluminum ladders are made at the Louisville Ladder plant in Louisville, Kentucky, where workers belong to United Steelworkers Local 1693, Unit 15.
items.caveats: Louisville Ladder also has plants in Smyrna, Tennessee and Monterrey, Mexico, and only the Louisville, Kentucky plant is confirmed union. Check the label on the ladder for the plant of manufacture.

items.name: Red Wing Shoes (Red Wing, MN plant)
items.what: Work and safety boots, along with the Red Wing Heritage line, are made at the company's plant in Red Wing, Minnesota. Fifteen styles are listed as union made, including the 606, 607, 608, 1155, 2231, 2233, 2245, 2405, 2406, 2408, 3505, 3507, 3508, 4441, and 953, and roughly seven hundred twenty five thousand of the two and a half million pairs made each year are union made in the US. The leather for these boots comes from S.B. Foot Tanning, also in Red Wing, where workers belong to United Food and Commercial Workers Local 1189.
items.union: UFCW Local 527 (Red Wing, MN); S.B. Foot Tanning UFCW Local 1189
items.caveats: Only the Red Wing, Minnesota plant is confirmed union. The Potosi, Missouri plant had a union petition filed in April 2022 but the outcome isn't confirmed, and the Clarksville, Arkansas plant isn't known to be union. Many Red Wing and Irish Setter styles are imported, so check the style number against the union list.

items.name: Thorogood (Weinbrenner Shoe Co.)
items.what: Thorogood's American Heritage, American Union Series, and other USA made work boots, including the moc toe wedge, the 1957 Series, and safety toe styles, are made by employee owned Weinbrenner Shoe Company at plants in Merrill and Marshfield, Wisconsin. A new fourteen and a half million dollar facility in Marshfield opened in 2025.
items.caveats: Only the lines labeled Made in USA are union made. Thorogood also sells imported styles, so check the label on the specific pair.

items.name: Carolina Shoe, Union Built (USA) line
items.what: Carolina's Union Built USA boots, including the Amp six inch and eight inch, Sarge, Ferric USA, and Foundry, are handcrafted at the Carolina Group factory in Martinsburg, Pennsylvania, using some globally sourced components.
items.caveats: Only styles carrying the Union Built USA badge count. Most of the rest of the Carolina catalog is imported.

items.name: Matterhorn (Carolina Group)
items.what: Matterhorn's Copper and Tailings series of mining and work boots are union built at the Carolina Group factory in Martinsburg, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: Only styles carrying the Union Built USA badge count.

items.name: Corcoran (Carolina Group)
items.what: Corcoran's ten inch Jump Boots and Marauder series are union built in Martinsburg, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: Only styles carrying the Union Built USA badge count.

items.name: Double-H Boots (Carolina Group)
items.what: Double-H's USA made work and western boots are built in Martinsburg, Pennsylvania, and are stocked as union label boots by union retailers.
items.caveats: Only the USA made, Union Built styles count. Double-H also imports some of its lineup.

items.name: Chippewa Boots (Carolina Group)
items.what: Chippewa's USA made styles are produced by Carolina Group in Martinsburg, Pennsylvania, and Chippewa is one of four Carolina Group brands listed as union made.
items.caveats: Chippewa's former plant in Carthage, Missouri has closed, so only styles now made in Martinsburg and badged USA or Union Built qualify. Most Chippewa product is imported.

items.name: Danner Boots (Portland, OR factory)
items.what: Danner makes boots including the Bull Run, Quarry USA, wildland fire, and military styles at its factory in Northeast Portland, Oregon. These boots carry a Made in the USA with Union Labor tag and have the US flag stitched on.
items.caveats: Only Portland made styles count. Danner, owned by LaCrosse and ABC-Mart, makes many of its other boots in Asia, so look for the union label and Made in USA tag.

items.name: Carhartt, Made in USA / Union Made line (Kentucky plants)
items.what: Certain Carhartt items are sewn at United Food and Commercial Workers plants in Kentucky, in Hanson, Madisonville, Irvine, and Edmonton. Examples include the J140 Duck Active Jacket, the J131 thermal lined jacket, the B01 double knee dungarees, R01 bib overalls, and other Made in USA duck jackets and bibs. The union label reads Union Assembled and Sewn in Hanson, KY USA.
items.caveats: The vast majority of Carhartt clothing is imported and not union made. Only items labeled Made in USA or Union Made qualify, and some of those say Made in USA of imported parts. The union status of the Camden, Tennessee plant isn't confirmed.

items.name: Wigwam Mills socks
items.what: Wigwam knits its work, hiking, and boot socks in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: Wigwam has cut over a hundred jobs in Sheboygan in recent years, so it's worth confirming production still happens there. Some Wigwam styles may be imported.

items.name: Union Line (National Safety Apparel, Chicago)
items.subcategory: Work pants, jeans, FR clothing, jackets
items.what: Union Line, made by National Safety Apparel in Chicago, Illinois, makes jeans, work pants, dungarees, hoodies, jackets, and industrial flame resistant cotton garments using Westex fabric, sewn across four sewing floors. It's a historic supplier of United Auto Workers and FDNY jackets.
items.union: Union-made (garment workers union; company states union-made — local not published)
items.caveats: The company describes itself as union made since 1907, but the specific union local, likely Workers United Chicago and Midwest Regional Joint Board, hasn't been confirmed from a union source. This is not the same company as Round House.

items.name: King Louie (now National Safety Apparel)
items.what: King Louie has made union made jackets, work shirts, and women's wear in the Kansas City, Kansas area since 1937. Its sewing facility was acquired by National Safety Apparel in January 2022.
items.union: Union-made (Workers United lineage; local not published)
items.caveats: Since this is a fairly recent acquisition, it's worth checking the current union status with National Safety Apparel before placing a bulk order.

items.name: Bayside Apparel (AST Sportswear), Union Made line
items.subcategory: T-shirts, pocket tees, fleece for printing
items.what: Bayside's Union Made blank tees and fleece, including styles 2905, 2955 long sleeve, 3015 pocket tee, 5100 tee, and various hoodies, are knit, dyed, and sewn at Bayside's own plants in Southern California. This is a standard blank used by union print shops.
items.union: Union-made (garment union — local not published by company)
items.caveats: Only styles explicitly tagged Union Made count, since Bayside also sells non union USA made items and a Nicaragua made line. The company doesn't name which union represents its workers, though it's widely sold by union print shops and union apparel retailers.

items.name: American Roots
items.what: American Roots cuts, sews, prints, and embroiders its heavyweight and lightweight fleece hoodies, sweatshirts, quarter zips, and t shirts in Westbrook, Maine, using materials sourced entirely in the US. About eighty five workers are union members.
items.caveats: Nothing significant to flag. The entire product line is made in the US by union workers.

items.name: Unionwear
items.subcategory: Hats/caps, tool belts, safety vests, bags
items.what: Unionwear makes baseball caps, campaign hats, safety vests, tool belts, tote bags, scrubs, and binders at its seventy thousand square foot factory in Newark, New Jersey, with about one hundred seventy five workers.
items.caveats: Nothing to flag. All products are made in Newark.

items.name: Fechheimer / Flying Cross (Grantsville, MD plant)
items.what: Flying Cross and Fechheimer public safety and military uniforms are sewn at the Grantsville, Maryland plant, which Workers United lists as a union shop. Fechheimer also runs plants in Cincinnati, Ohio and Hodgenville, Kentucky.
items.caveats: Only the Grantsville, Maryland plant is confirmed union by Workers United. Fechheimer also sources from Central and South America, Europe, and Asia, so ask the retailer which plant made a given item.

items.name: Elbeco (Reading, PA)
items.what: Elbeco makes public safety uniform shirts, pants, and flame resistant station wear in Reading, Pennsylvania. It was the first major uniform maker to endorse the SweatFree Communities program.
items.caveats: Elbeco, now part of LION, also imports some of its lines, so confirm which styles are US made.

items.name: Stetson / Resistol hats (Hat-Co, Longview & Garland, TX)
items.what: Stetson and Resistol felt and straw hats are made by Hat-Co in Longview and Garland, Texas.
items.caveats: Some Stetson and Resistol straw hats and licensed apparel are imported. The union made items are the US made felt hats.

items.name: Swany gloves (Gloversville, NY)
items.what: Swany leather and winter gloves are made at the company's plant in Gloversville, New York, which Workers United lists as a union shop.
items.caveats: Many Swany ski gloves are imported, so only Gloversville made styles are union made. Check the label.

items.name: Keystone Uniform Cap (Philadelphia, PA)
items.what: Keystone makes uniform caps and service hats for police, fire, transit, and military use in Philadelphia.

items.name: Cintas Uniforms, postal division (Fort Smith, AR)
items.what: USPS letter carrier uniforms are sewn at Cintas's postal division plant in Fort Smith, Arkansas.
items.caveats: Only the Fort Smith postal division is listed as union. Cintas as a company is largely non union.

items.name: Accent Uniforms (Eddystone, PA)
items.what: Accent Uniforms are manufactured in Eddystone, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: This is a contract uniform program manufacturer, so retail availability is limited.

items.name: Lifewear, Inc. (Pottstown, PA)
items.what: Lifewear sews uniforms and scrubs in Pottstown, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: This is a business to business uniform maker.

items.name: Schott NYC leather & wool jackets
items.what: Schott's Made in USA leather motorcycle jackets, pea coats, and wool jackets are made at the company's factory in the Elizabeth and South Amboy area of New Jersey.
items.caveats: Only Made in USA labeled Schott styles count, since Schott also imports. The union claim comes from a union made list published by Electrical Workers Local 407, not from Schott itself.

items.name: Sterlingwear of Boston pea coats
items.what: Sterlingwear makes Navy style wool pea coats and other outerwear in East Boston, Massachusetts, and has been a US Navy pea coat contractor since 1968.
items.caveats: The union claim comes from a union made list published by Electrical Workers Local 407, so it's worth confirming the current contract.

items.name: New England Shirt Company
items.what: New England Shirt Company makes dress and sport shirts, including work style flannels and chambray, in Fall River, Massachusetts.
items.union: UNITE HERE Local 177 (New England Joint Board)

items.name: Union Made Apparel (custom printing)
items.what: Union Made Apparel is a union print shop that sells and prints union made blank apparel, such as Bayside shirts and Unionwear caps, for union locals, adding a union bug to the printing.
items.union: Union print shop (uses union-made Bayside/Unionwear blanks)
items.caveats: This is a printer and reseller, so the union made status comes from the blank garment and the print shop itself. The specific local isn't published.

items.name: Union House Apparel / UnionLabel.com
items.what: This is a union member run retailer selling union made workwear, including Carhartt items from Hanson, Kentucky, Thorogood boots, Union Line jeans, King Louie jackets, Wigwam socks, Union House briefs and boxers, and Big Bill workwear.
items.union: Retailer affiliated with Union Label & Service Trades Dept, AFL-CIO
items.caveats: This is a retailer, not a manufacturer. Not everything it sells, such as Round House, New Balance, or Camber, is union made, so check each product's label.

items.name: All American Clothing Co., Union-Made collection
items.subcategory: Retailer — union-made denim shirts, jackets, socks, boots
items.what: The Union Made collection includes a long sleeve denim shirt, a canvas jacket, a cotton mock turtleneck, Wigwam socks, and Thorogood boots. Its sister site, AllUSAClothing, sells Union Line and Bayside union made lines.
items.union: Mixed (Wigwam UFCW, Thorogood UFCW, Union Line/Bayside garment unions)
items.caveats: All American Clothing's own jeans are made in the USA but not stated as union made. Only the items in the Union Made collection qualify.

items.name: The Union Boot Pro / UnionMadeBoots.com
items.what: These are long running retailers, in business over thirty seven years, that specialize in union made boots, including Thorogood, Carolina Union Built styles, Danner boots made in Portland, and Double-H, plus Wigwam work socks.
items.union: Resells UFCW-made boots (Weinbrenner, Carolina Group, Danner)
items.caveats: These are retailers, so verify that each style listed is the USA made, union made version.

items.name: Dearborn Denim & Apparel
items.what: Dearborn Denim cuts and sews jeans, button downs, jackets, tees, and sweatshirts in a twenty five thousand square foot factory in Chicago, with about sixty workers making around five hundred pairs of jeans a day.
items.union: Unionized factory per Promote Unions (union not named)
items.caveats: The only source claiming union status is a union merchandise blog. The company itself and its profile with the American made apparel movement don't mention a union, so confirm before treating this as verified.

items.name: Sawicki & Son (Detroit), union printing
items.what: Sawicki & Son, based in Detroit, is a union print shop for t shirts, jackets, caps, and sweatshirts, listed in union buy American resource guides.
items.union: Union print shop (Union Label & Service Trades Dept resource list)
items.caveats: This is a printer, so the garment blanks used may vary. Ask for union made blanks specifically.

items.name: Brooks Brothers (Garland, NC shirt factory)
items.what: Brooks Brothers dress and sport shirts are made at the company's factory in Garland, North Carolina.
items.union: Workers United (SEIU); UFCW list cites UNITE HERE
items.caveats: Only Made in USA shirts from the Garland plant count, since most Brooks Brothers product is imported. The company went through bankruptcy in 2020, so confirm the plant is still running before relying on this.

items.name: Ford F-150 / F-150 Raptor / F-150 Lightning
items.what: The F-150 is built at the Dearborn Truck Plant in Dearborn, Michigan, where workers belong to United Auto Workers Local 600, and at Kansas City Assembly in Claycomo, Missouri, represented by Local 249. The F-150 Lightning was built at the Rouge EV Center in Dearborn. All F-150 production is United Auto Workers made.
items.caveats: The F-150 Lightning is discontinued. Ford ended production for the 2025 model year in December 2025 and hasn't announced a restart date for the Rouge EV Center, reassigning those workers to Dearborn Truck instead. Ford has promised a range extended successor later on. For now, only leftover Lightning inventory is available. Gas and hybrid F-150 trucks from Dearborn and Kansas City are still being built by union workers.

items.name: Ford F-250/350/450/550 Super Duty
items.what: These are built at the Kentucky Truck Plant in Louisville, Kentucky, represented by United Auto Workers Local 862, and at Ohio Assembly in Avon Lake, Ohio. Starting in 2026, production also runs at Oakville, Ontario, represented by Unifor Local 707.
items.caveats: All three plants are union, so there's no non union source for this model.

items.name: Ford F-650 / F-750 and E-Series Cutaway
items.what: These are built at the Ohio Assembly Plant in Avon Lake, Ohio.

items.name: Ford Ranger / Ranger Raptor and Bronco / Bronco Raptor
items.what: These are built at the Michigan Assembly Plant in Wayne, Michigan.
items.caveats: The Bronco Sport is not part of this. It's built in Hermosillo, Mexico.

items.name: Ford Explorer / Explorer Hybrid and Lincoln Aviator
items.what: These are built at the Chicago Assembly Plant in Chicago, Illinois.

items.name: Ford Expedition and Lincoln Navigator
items.what: These are built at the Kentucky Truck Plant in Louisville, Kentucky.

items.name: Ford Escape / Escape Hybrid and Lincoln Corsair / Corsair Hybrid
items.what: These were built at the Louisville Assembly Plant in Louisville, Kentucky.
items.caveats: Production ended at Louisville Assembly in December 2025, with the final unit sold in September 2026. Any Escape or Corsair still on a lot is leftover 2025 or 2026 stock. Ford is retooling this plant for a new low cost electric vehicle platform, so treat this model as discontinued with remaining stock only.

items.name: Ford Mustang / Mustang GT / Dark Horse
items.what: These are built at the Flat Rock Assembly Plant in Flat Rock, Michigan.
items.caveats: The Mustang Mach-E is not union built. It comes from Cuautitlan, Mexico.

items.name: Ford Transit / E-Transit
items.what: These are built at the Kansas City Assembly Plant in Claycomo, Missouri.
items.caveats: The Transit Connect is discontinued and was imported. Only the full size Transit is union built.

items.name: Chevrolet Silverado 1500 / GMC Sierra 1500
items.what: Union built trucks come from Fort Wayne Assembly in Roanoke, Indiana, represented by United Auto Workers Local 2209, and from Oshawa Assembly in Ontario, represented by Unifor Local 222. Trucks built in Silao, Mexico are not union made.
items.caveats: Check the first digit of the VIN. A 1 means Fort Wayne, a 2 means Oshawa, and a 3 means Silao, which you'd want to avoid. Oshawa cut its third shift in January 2026, cutting about a thousand jobs. Analyst reports from June 2026 say the light duty Silverado may leave Oshawa by the end of 2026 when the next generation truck launches, leaving only heavy duty production there, though GM Canada denies this. The Sierra 1500 is only built at Fort Wayne and Silao, not Oshawa.

items.name: Chevrolet Silverado HD / GMC Sierra HD (2500/3500)
items.what: Union built heavy duty trucks come from Flint Assembly in Flint, Michigan, represented by United Auto Workers Local 598, for both Silverado and Sierra, and from Oshawa, Ontario, represented by Unifor Local 222, for Silverado HD only. GM added more HD output at Flint in March 2026.
items.caveats: For the 2026 model year, the Sierra HD is built only at Flint. No evidence turned up of any Mexican built Sierra HD, despite an older list suggesting otherwise, so check the VIN if you want to be sure, but there's no documented Mexican HD production for 2026.

items.name: Chevrolet Silverado EV / GMC Sierra EV / GMC Hummer EV (pickup & SUV) / Cadillac Escalade IQ & IQ L
items.what: These electric models are built at Factory ZERO, the former Detroit-Hamtramck Assembly plant, in Detroit, Michigan. They ride on GM's Ultium platform, with battery cells coming from Ultium Cells, covered in a separate entry.

items.name: Chevrolet Silverado 4500HD/5500HD/6500HD (medium-duty)
items.what: These medium duty trucks are built by Navistar and International at Springfield, Ohio under contract with GM.
items.caveats: This model appears on the union made list, but the Springfield plant attribution comes from industry reporting rather than the union's own guide.

items.name: Chevrolet Colorado / GMC Canyon; Chevrolet Express / GMC Savana (incl. cutaways)
items.what: These are built at Wentzville Assembly in Wentzville, Missouri.

items.name: Chevrolet Tahoe / Suburban, GMC Yukon / Yukon XL, Cadillac Escalade / Escalade ESV
items.what: These are built at Arlington Assembly in Arlington, Texas.

items.name: Chevrolet Traverse, Buick Enclave, GMC Acadia
items.what: These are built at Lansing Delta Township Assembly in Lansing, Michigan.
items.caveats: Other Buick models, the Envision, Encore GX, and Envista, are imported from China or Korea and are not union built.

brand: chevrolet traverse, buick enclave, gmc acadia

items.name: Cadillac CT4 / CT4-V / CT5 / CT5-V (Blackwing)
items.what: These are built at Lansing Grand River Assembly in Lansing, Michigan.

items.name: Cadillac Celestiq
items.what: This is hand built at the GM Global Technical Center in Warren, Michigan.

items.name: Cadillac Lyriq / Vistiq / XT5
items.what: These are built at Spring Hill Assembly in Spring Hill, Tennessee.
items.caveats: The Cadillac Optiq, built in Mexico, and the XT4, built in Fairfax, Kansas but not on the current union made list, are not included here.

items.name: Chevrolet Corvette (Stingray, Z06, E-Ray, ZR1)
items.what: The Stingray, Z06, E-Ray, and ZR1 are built at Bowling Green Assembly in Bowling Green, Kentucky.

items.name: Chevrolet Bolt (2027 model, next-gen)
items.what: This is built at Fairfax Assembly in Kansas City, Kansas, where workers belong to United Auto Workers Local 31. Production started in November 2025 with deliveries beginning in January 2026.
items.caveats: The initial production ramp has been slow. The Chevrolet Equinox EV and Blazer EV, built in Ramos Arizpe, Mexico, along with the gas powered Equinox and Blazer, also built in Mexico, are not union made.

items.name: Jeep Wrangler / Gladiator
items.what: These are built at the Toledo Assembly Complex in Toledo, Ohio.
items.caveats: The Jeep Compass, built in Toluca, Mexico and expected to move to Brampton, Ontario under Unifor in the future, and the Renegade, are not part of this.

items.name: Jeep Grand Cherokee / Grand Cherokee L and Dodge Durango
items.what: These are built at the Detroit Assembly Complex, which includes the Mack and Jefferson North plants, in Detroit, Michigan.

items.name: Jeep Wagoneer / Grand Wagoneer / Grand Wagoneer L / Grand Wagoneer REEV
items.what: These are built at Warren Truck Assembly in Warren, Michigan.

items.name: Ram 1500
items.what: Union built trucks come from Sterling Heights Assembly in Sterling Heights, Michigan, where workers belong to United Auto Workers Local 1700. Trucks built in Saltillo, Mexico are not union made, and that plant is also where the Ram HD 2500 and 3500 and the ProMaster van are built, none of which are on the union made list.
items.caveats: Check the first digit of the VIN. A 1 means Sterling Heights. The Ram HD and ProMaster are entirely built in Mexico.

items.name: Volkswagen Atlas / Atlas Cross Sport / ID.4
items.what: These are built at Chattanooga Assembly in Chattanooga, Tennessee. Workers voted to join the United Auto Workers in April 2024, and their first contract was ratified in February 2026 with 96 percent approval, represented by Local 42. This is now on the official union built list.
items.caveats: Only these three models, built in Chattanooga, count. Every other Volkswagen, including the Jetta, Tiguan, and Taos, built in Mexico, and the GTI and Golf R, built in Germany, is not union built.

items.name: Dodge Charger (2-door/4-door, Sixpack) / Charger Daytona EV
items.what: These are built at Windsor Assembly in Windsor, Ontario.
items.caveats: This model appears on both the United Auto Workers guide, in its Unifor section, and on Unifor's own guide.

items.name: Chrysler Pacifica / Pacifica Hybrid / Voyager / Grand Caravan (Canada)
items.what: These are built at Windsor Assembly in Windsor, Ontario.

items.name: Chevrolet Silverado 1500 / Silverado HD (Oshawa-built)
items.what: The crew cab light duty and heavy duty Silverado built at Oshawa Assembly in Oshawa, Ontario.
items.caveats: These carry a VIN starting with the number 2. Oshawa cut a shift in 2025 because of tariffs.

items.name: Ford Super Duty (Oakville, Ontario - from 2026)
items.what: The Oakville Assembly Complex was retooled from building the Edge and Nautilus to building the F-Series Super Duty, with production starting in 2026 under a 1.25 billion dollar deal between Ford and Unifor.
items.caveats: Production launched in the third quarter of 2026, starting with gas and diesel Super Duty trucks, with capacity for up to about one hundred thousand a year and some exported to the US. Early 2027 model year Oakville built trucks should be reaching dealers by now. Check that the first digit of the VIN is 2, which indicates Canada, and confirm current shipping volumes if it matters to you.

items.name: Ultium Cells (GM/LG) EV battery cells
items.what: Ultium Cells makes the battery cells for GM's Ultium electric vehicles, including the Silverado EV, Sierra EV, Hummer EV, Lyriq, and Escalade IQ, plus the Bolt. Cells come from Warren and Lordstown, Ohio, where workers belong to United Auto Workers Local 1112, organized in 2022 with a contract in 2023, and from Spring Hill, Tennessee, where workers joined the union in 2024 through a card check process under the 2023 GM master agreement.
items.caveats: This is a component supplier rather than a consumer product, but it matters because it confirms these GM electric vehicles are union made from the battery up. The union status of the Lansing, Michigan Ultium Cells plant, known as Ultium Cells 3, is worth checking.

items.name: BlueOval SK (Ford/SK On) EV battery plant, Glendale, KY
items.what: BlueOval SK, a joint venture between Ford and SK On, makes battery cells for Ford electric vehicles at its plant in Glendale, Kentucky. Workers voted to join the United Auto Workers in August 2025 by a margin of about eleven votes, and the company challenged the result.
items.caveats: BlueOval SK withdrew its election objections in November 2025, but as of early 2026 there's still no announced certification or bargaining, and reporting from February 2026 describes progress as having slowed. This plant should be considered still organizing, not yet union made. Ford's BlueOval City plant in Stanton, Tennessee falls under the UAW master agreement from the 2023 deal but isn't producing consumer vehicles yet.

items.name: Goodyear tires - Topeka, KS plant
items.what: This plant makes light truck, medium truck, commercial, and off the road tires, marked with Department of Transportation plant codes JN, MJ, and PY.
items.caveats: Only Goodyear's Steelworkers plants count for union made status: Topeka, Danville, and Fayetteville, which is closing in 2027, plus the former Cooper plants in Findlay and Texarkana. Goodyear's plants in Lawton, Oklahoma and Tupelo, Mississippi are not union, so check the Department of Transportation code on the sidewall.

items.name: Goodyear tires - Danville, VA plant
items.what: This plant makes aviation tires and some truck tires, marked with codes JE, MC, and PT.
items.caveats: Most medium truck production has moved to other plants, so consumer tire output here is limited.

items.name: Goodyear / Kelly-Springfield tires - Fayetteville, NC plant
items.what: This plant makes passenger and light truck tires, about thirty one thousand passenger tires and ten thousand five hundred light truck tires a day, marked with codes JF, MM, and PJ.
items.caveats: Goodyear announced this plant's closure in May 2026, and Goodyear and the Steelworkers reached a closing agreement in July 2026, with production ending by the end of 2027 and about seventeen hundred jobs represented by Steelworkers Local 959L affected. Tires with these codes remain union made until then.

items.name: Cooper Tires (Goodyear-owned) - Findlay, OH plant
items.what: This Goodyear owned plant makes passenger and light truck tires, about twenty three thousand a day, marked with code UP.
items.caveats: Cooper's Tupelo, Mississippi plant is not union, and Cooper also imports tires from Mexico, Serbia, and China. Check for code UP or UT on the sidewall.

items.name: Cooper Tires (Goodyear-owned) - Texarkana, AR plant
items.what: This Goodyear owned plant makes consumer passenger and light truck tires, about thirty two thousand a day, marked with code UT.
items.caveats: A new contract was ratified in June 2024.

items.name: Bridgestone / Firestone tires - Des Moines, IA plant
items.what: This plant makes agricultural and off road tires, marked with codes VE, YE, YU, and 8B.
items.caveats: Bridgestone's Aiken, South Carolina and Wilson, North Carolina passenger tire plants are not union. The truck and bus radial plant in LaVergne, Tennessee closed in July 2025.

items.name: Bridgestone / Firestone tires - Warren County (Morrison), TN plant
items.what: This plant makes truck and bus radial tires for both the Bridgestone and Firestone commercial lines, marked with codes 2C, 4D, and 5D.
items.caveats: This plant absorbed production from the LaVergne plant after it closed in 2025.

items.name: Bridgestone retread / components - Akron OH, Bloomington IL, Russellville AR
items.what: These plants make Bandag retread rubber in Bloomington, Illinois, represented by Local 787L, run a tech center in Akron, Ohio, represented by Local 7L, and operate a plant in Russellville, Arkansas, represented by Local 884L.
items.caveats: These are commercial and fleet products, not consumer tires.

items.name: BFGoodrich (Michelin) tires - Tuscaloosa, AL plant
items.what: This plant makes BFGoodrich light truck and passenger tires, including the All-Terrain T/A KO series, marked with code BE.
items.caveats: Only two BFGoodrich plants are union, this one and the Fort Wayne and Woodburn plant. Michelin branded plants in the US, including Greenville, Spartanburg, and Lexington, South Carolina, Dothan, Alabama, and Ardmore, Oklahoma, are not union.

items.name: BFGoodrich (Michelin) tires - Woodburn / Fort Wayne, IN plant
items.what: This plant makes BFGoodrich and some Uniroyal passenger and light truck tires, marked with code BF.
items.caveats: Check for code BF on the sidewall.

items.name: Yokohama Tire - Salem, VA plant
items.what: This plant makes passenger and light truck tires, including the Geolandar and Avid lines, marked with code CC.
items.caveats: Yokohama's commercial tire plant in West Point, Mississippi is not union, and Yokohama tires made in Japan are not Steelworkers made either.

items.name: Titan Tire - Freeport, IL; Des Moines, IA; Bryan, OH
items.what: These plants make Titan brand and licensed Goodyear Farm Tires for agricultural, construction, and off the road use, marked with codes JH, MN, and PK in Freeport, CF in Des Moines, and a B prefix plus serial number in Bryan.
items.caveats: The Bryan, Ohio plant has seen repeated layoffs, so it's worth confirming current output there.

items.name: Kumho Tire - Macon, GA plant
items.what: This plant makes passenger and light truck tires, including the Crugen, Solus, and Ecsta lines. It was the first union organized tire plant built in the US in forty years, with Steelworkers winning a vote in 2021 and a first contract in 2023.
items.caveats: Only tires built at Macon count. Most Kumho tires are imported from Korea, Vietnam, or China. This plant isn't on some of the older union made lists yet, so check the Department of Transportation plant code for Macon specifically.

items.name: Goodyear tires - Medicine Hat, Alberta plant
items.what: This plant makes passenger and light truck tires, marked with codes JU, PC, and UK.

items.name: Clarios lead-acid car batteries - Holland (Toledo), OH plant
items.what: This plant makes twelve volt batteries sold under the DieHard, Duralast, and various automaker labels for Ford and GM, producing roughly one hundred twenty to one hundred fifty thousand batteries a week. Clarios is also a major supplier to Interstate Batteries.
items.caveats: Clarios runs about eighteen plants in the US and only some are union. Battery labels don't show which plant made them, so you'd need to ask the retailer for the manufacturer code. Interstate also sources from non union suppliers, such as East Penn and Deka in Pennsylvania, which is widely reported to be non union though that isn't confirmed here.

items.name: FRAM oil filters - Greenville, OH
items.what: FRAM motor oil filters are listed as coming from a plant in Greenville, Ohio, according to a United Auto Workers made products directory.
items.caveats: That directory entry may be out of date. FRAM, now owned by First Brands, also imports many filters, so check for Made in USA on the box.

items.name: Dana axles and driveshafts
items.what: Dana Corporation makes axles and driveshafts in Louisville and Dry Ridge, Kentucky, represented by Locals 3058 and 3064, along with Spicer branded aftermarket parts.
items.caveats: This is based on a United Auto Workers products directory. Dana runs many other plants, some union and some not.

items.name: Allison Transmission - Indianapolis, IN
items.what: Allison makes commercial and medium duty automatic transmissions in Indianapolis, Indiana, used in the Silverado and Sierra HD with the Duramax engine, as well as in RVs and buses.

items.name: Harley-Davidson motorcycles - York, PA final assembly
items.what: Touring, Softail, Trike, and CVO models get their final assembly at York Vehicle Operations in York, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: A five year contract with the Machinists union was ratified in August 2022. Some smaller Revolution Max models, like the Sportster S, Nightster, and Pan America, have been built in Thailand, but Harley-Davidson announced in June 2026 that Revolution Max production is moving back to US plants. Check the eleventh digit of the VIN and look for the Assembled in USA badge.

items.name: Harley-Davidson powertrain (Menomonee Falls, WI) and Tomahawk, WI components
items.what: Milwaukee-Eight engines and transmissions are made at Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, represented by Steelworkers Local 2-209 and Machinists Lodge 78. Windshields, saddlebags, sidecars, and Tour-Pak luggage come from Tomahawk, Wisconsin, represented by Steelworkers Local 460.
items.caveats: Contracts at both plants were ratified in April 2024.

items.name: John Deere lawn tractors and riding mowers - Horicon, WI
items.what: John Deere's residential lawn tractors, in the 100, 200, and 300 series, and X-series, along with Gator utility vehicles, are built at Horicon Works in Horicon, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: Deere's other lawn products, like the zero turn mowers from Greeneville, Tennessee, are not union made, so check for a Made in Horicon marking or the serial plate. Deere shifted some mower production lines to Mexico in 2024 and 2025.

brand: john deere lawn tractors and riding mowers

items.name: John Deere agricultural equipment and engines (Iowa/Illinois)
items.what: Tractors are built in Waterloo, Iowa, combines in East Moline, Illinois, planters and sprayers in Moline and Des Moines, and diesel engines in Waterloo. Workers belong to United Auto Workers Locals 74, 94, 281, 434, 450, 838, and 865.
items.caveats: Deere's compact tractors, in the 1 through 4 series, are largely imported from India and Japan and are not union made.

brand: john deere agricultural equipment and engines

items.name: Case IH / CNH tractors and combines (Racine, WI; Burlington, IA)
items.what: Magnum tractors are built in Racine, Wisconsin, represented by United Auto Workers Local 180, and backhoes and loaders come from Burlington, Iowa, represented by Local 807.

items.name: Anheuser-Busch (Budweiser, Bud Light, Michelob, Busch, Natural Light, Shock Top, Rolling Rock, Landshark, O'Doul's, Stella Artois/Beck's US-brewed)
items.what: All twelve of Anheuser-Busch InBev's US company owned breweries are union, in St. Louis, Fort Collins, Fairfield California, Baldwinsville New York, Merrimack New Hampshire, Williamsburg Virginia, Cartersville Georgia, Jacksonville, Houston, Los Angeles or Van Nuys, Columbus, and Newark. That covers Budweiser, Bud Light, Michelob, Busch, Natural Light, Shock Top, Rolling Rock, Landshark, O'Doul's, and the US brewed versions of Stella Artois and Beck's.
items.caveats: Stella Artois, Beck's, Corona, and Modelo sold with import labeling are not US union made. Goose Island's Chicago brewery on Fulton Street is non union, though the larger volume Goose Island beers are actually made at the union Anheuser-Busch plants.

items.name: Molson Coors (Miller Lite, Miller High Life, MGD, Coors Banquet, Coors Light, Blue Moon, Leinenkugel's, Keystone)
items.what: Miller Lite, Miller High Life, Miller Genuine Draft, Coors Banquet, Coors Light, Blue Moon, Leinenkugel's, and Keystone come from union plants in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, represented by United Auto Workers Local 9, Trenton, Ohio, also United Auto Workers, Fort Worth, Texas, represented by the Teamsters, and Albany, Georgia, represented by the Machinists. Leinenkugel's is brewed in Chippewa Falls, Wisconsin, represented by the Teamsters.
items.caveats: The Golden, Colorado flagship brewery is essentially non union, with only a handful of Operating Engineers Local 9 members, and the Shenandoah, Virginia plant is non union too. The Irwindale, California plant closed in 2020 and the Eden, North Carolina plant closed in 2016, both formerly Teamsters. The can code identifies which plant a given can came from.

items.name: Samuel Adams / Boston Beer (Sam Adams, Angry Orchard, Twisted Tea bottles, Truly)
items.what: Sam Adams, Angry Orchard, bottled Twisted Tea, and Truly come from the Cincinnati, Ohio brewery, the former Hudepohl-Schoenling site, where workers belong to Teamsters Local 1199.
items.caveats: There were unfair labor practice charges filed in February 2025 involving newer Local 1199 members who hadn't reached a first contract yet. The Teamsters list Twisted Tea as covering bottles only, not cans. The union status of the Breinigsville, Pennsylvania brewery isn't confirmed. In August 2026, staff at the Boston, in the Jamaica Plain neighborhood, brewery and taproom announced an organizing drive with United Food and Commercial Workers Local 328, but that location isn't union yet. About twenty four percent of Boston Beer's volume, as of 2024, is brewed under contract by third parties.

items.name: Genesee / Dundee / Seneca (Genesee Brewing, Rochester NY)
items.what: Genesee, Genny Light, Genesee Cream Ale, and Dundee craft beers come from the Genesee Brewing plant in Rochester, New York.

items.name: Matt Brewing Co. (Saranac, Utica Club)
items.what: Saranac beers and Utica Club come from the Matt Brewing Company plant in Utica, New York.

items.name: Stevens Point Brewery (Point beers, Whole Hog, Ciderboys)
items.what: Point beers, Whole Hog, and Ciderboys come from the brewery in Stevens Point, Wisconsin.

items.name: August Schell Brewing (Schell's, Grain Belt)
items.what: Schell's and Grain Belt come from the August Schell brewery in New Ulm, Minnesota.

items.name: Lionshead / Stegmaier (Lion Brewery, Wilkes-Barre PA)
items.what: Lionshead, Stegmaier, and various contract brands come from the Lion Brewery in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania.

items.name: Minhas Craft Brewery (Monroe WI, Huber, Berghoff, Rhinelander)
items.what: Minhas brews its own Huber, Berghoff, and Rhinelander beers, along with many private label brands under contract, at its brewery in Monroe, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: Rhinelander Export Lager doesn't show up as union on at least one union backed list, so check the label.

items.name: City Brewing (contract brewer: Latrobe PA, La Crosse WI)
items.what: City Brewing is a contract brewer that brews and cans many contract beers, seltzers, and ready to drink beverages at its plants in La Crosse, Wisconsin, represented by Teamsters Local 695, and Latrobe, Pennsylvania, represented by the Communications Workers of America.
items.caveats: Since this is a contract brewer, which brands it makes can change from year to year. Pabst uses both City Brewing and Molson Coors plants for its beers.

items.name: Labatt (Canada) / Moosehead
items.what: Labatt's Canadian breweries are represented by the Teamsters, and Moosehead's brewery in Saint John, New Brunswick is also Teamsters represented.
items.caveats: Labatt beer sold in the US is brewed in Canada. Some Labatt plants are represented by Unifor rather than the Teamsters.

items.name: Pabst / Schlitz / Old Style / Rainier / Lone Star
items.what: Pabst doesn't own any breweries itself. Its beers are brewed under contract at union Molson Coors plants, including Milwaukee, represented by United Auto Workers, and Fort Worth, represented by the Teamsters, as well as at City Brewing.
items.caveats: Which plant brews a given can depends on your region, and some Pabst family brands are contracted to non union breweries.

items.name: Jim Beam (Beam Suntory), Jim Beam, Knob Creek, Booker's, Basil Hayden
items.what: Jim Beam, Knob Creek, Booker's, and Basil Hayden are distilled and bottled at Beam Suntory's Clermont and Boston, Kentucky facilities.

items.name: Maker's Mark
items.what: Maker's Mark is distilled at the company's distillery in Loretto, Kentucky.

items.name: Heaven Hill (Evan Williams, Elijah Craig, Larceny, Old Fitzgerald)
items.what: Evan Williams, Elijah Craig, Larceny, and Old Fitzgerald are bottled and warehoused by workers in Bardstown, Kentucky, represented by United Food and Commercial Workers Local 23D, who held a six week strike in 2021.
items.caveats: Workers took buyouts in 2024 after the strike. A petition to decertify the union at Heaven Hill's Bernheim Distillery in Louisville was filed in December 2025 but failed, with workers voting 27 to 14 to keep United Food and Commercial Workers Local 23D, certified in February 2026. So both the Bardstown and Bernheim sites are union.

items.name: Four Roses Bourbon
items.what: Four Roses is distilled at the Lawrenceburg, Kentucky distillery and bottled at the Cox's Creek facility.

items.name: Wild Turkey (Campari)
items.what: This bourbon is made at the Wild Turkey distillery in Lawrenceburg, Kentucky.

items.name: Buffalo Trace / Sazerac (Buffalo Trace, Eagle Rare, W.L. Weller, Blanton's)
items.what: Buffalo Trace, Eagle Rare, W.L. Weller, and Blanton's all come from the Frankfort, Kentucky distillery.
items.caveats: Sazerac runs other plants too, like the Fireball plant near Owensboro and Bardstown, and those are separate operations. Fireball also shows up on the UFCW Local 880 list.

items.name: Barton 1792 Distillery (1792, Very Old Barton)
items.what: 1792 and Very Old Barton are made at the Barton 1792 Distillery in Bardstown, Kentucky.

items.name: Woodford Reserve / Old Forester (Brown-Forman)
items.what: Woodford Reserve is distilled in Versailles, Kentucky, and Old Forester is made and bottled in Louisville, Kentucky, both under Brown-Forman.
items.caveats: Brown-Forman's Jack Daniel's plant in Lynchburg, Tennessee is a separate site, and we could not confirm whether it's unionized.

items.name: Holladay Distillery / McCormick Distilling (Weston MO)
items.what: Ben Holladay bourbon and McCormick vodka and whiskey are made at the McCormick Distilling plant in Weston, Missouri.

items.name: E&J Gallo (Gallo, Barefoot, Andre, Carlo Rossi, Louis Martini, Mirassou, Ecco Domani, J Vineyards, New Amsterdam)
items.what: Gallo, Barefoot, Andre, Carlo Rossi, Louis Martini, Mirassou, Ecco Domani, J Vineyards, and New Amsterdam are produced and bottled at E&J Gallo's Modesto, California plant, where workers are represented by UFCW (United Food and Commercial Workers) and IBT (International Brotherhood of Teamsters). Gallo of Sonoma's vineyards work under a UFW (United Farm Workers) contract.
items.caveats: This is a big portfolio, and imported labels like Ecco Domani are actually made abroad.

items.name: Chateau Ste. Michelle / Columbia Crest / 14 Hands (Ste. Michelle Wine Estates)
items.what: Chateau Ste. Michelle, Columbia Crest, and 14 Hands come from Ste. Michelle Wine Estates' winery in Woodinville, Washington, sourced from Columbia Valley vineyards.

items.name: Robert Mondavi / Woodbridge / Ravenswood / Toasted Head
items.what: Woodbridge wine is made at the Woodbridge winery in Acampo, California.
items.caveats: Ravenswood and Toasted Head have changed hands since this list was put together, so check who currently owns them before counting on this.

items.name: Franzia / Almaden / Paul Masson / Cupcake (The Wine Group)
items.what: Franzia, Almaden, Paul Masson, and Cupcake come from The Wine Group's wineries in Ripon and Lodi, California.

items.name: Coca-Cola (Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, Dasani, Minute Maid, Barq's)
items.what: Coke, Diet Coke, Sprite, Fanta, Powerade, Dasani, Minute Maid, and Barq's are bottled at many different Coca-Cola plants, with Teamsters representing workers at places like Chicago (Local 727), New York City (Local 812), and Philadelphia (Local 830), and UFCW at some plants too.
items.caveats: Union status depends on which bottler filled your can, not the brand. Coca-Cola Consolidated, which bottles for the Southeast, actually does have Teamsters units in several places: West Virginia (Local 175 has been in contract fights from 2024 to 2026), Cincinnati (Local 1199 won a first contract in 2023), and Fort Wayne, Indiana (a 2025 strike). So don't assume Consolidated is all non-union. Also, some union Coke plants near New York have closed. Your best bet is to check the local bottler.

items.name: PepsiCo beverages (Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Gatorade, Tropicana, Aquafina)
items.what: Pepsi, Mountain Dew, Gatorade, Tropicana, and Aquafina come from many Pepsi bottling and distribution centers, where Teamsters represent workers, and some processing plants where UFCW does.
items.caveats: Union status depends on the specific bottler or plant, not the brand name, and many Pepsi Beverages Co. plants in the South and West are not union. Also, Tropicana isn't owned by PepsiCo anymore. It was sold to PAI Partners in 2021, with PepsiCo keeping a minority stake.

items.name: Keurig Dr Pepper / American Bottling (Dr Pepper, 7UP, A&W, Canada Dry, Snapple, Mott's, Hawaiian Punch, Sunkist)
items.what: Dr Pepper, 7UP, A&W, Canada Dry, Snapple, Mott's, Hawaiian Punch, and Sunkist are bottled by American Bottling Company plants, with UFCW representing workers at some Dr Pepper plants.
items.caveats: In much of the country, Dr Pepper and 7UP are actually bottled under contract by local Coke or Pepsi bottlers, so the union status follows whichever bottler filled it, not Keurig Dr Pepper as a company. Check your local plant.

items.name: Adirondack Beverages (Adirondack sodas, Waist Watcher, private-label)
items.what: Adirondack sodas, Waist Watcher, and private-label soda are made at the plant in Scotia, New York.

items.name: Ocean Spray
items.what: Ocean Spray cranberry juice and sauce come from several plants, including Kenosha, Wisconsin, where workers are represented by both Teamsters and IAM (International Association of Machinists), and Markham/Aberdeen, Washington, where Teamsters Local 252 ratified a contract in April 2023.
items.caveats: Not every Ocean Spray plant is union. The Middleboro, Massachusetts headquarters plant isn't confirmed as an IAM site despite being the company's home base. Workers at the Wisconsin Rapids, Wisconsin plant voted against joining IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers) Local 965 in February 2024, and the Tomah and Babcock, Wisconsin plants are non-union. Cranberry products from non-union plants carry the same label, so you can't tell from the package.

items.name: Welch's
items.what: Welch's grape juice and jelly are made at plants in North East, Pennsylvania and Lawton, Michigan.

items.name: Nabisco / Mondelez (Oreo, Ritz, Chips Ahoy!, Wheat Thins, Honey Maid, Premium, Triscuit, belVita)
items.what: Oreo, Ritz, Chips Ahoy!, Wheat Thins, Honey Maid, Premium, Triscuit, and belVita come from union bakeries represented by BCTGM (Bakery, Confectionery, Tobacco Workers and Grain Millers) in Chicago (Marquette Park, Local 1), Portland, Oregon (Local 364), Richmond, Virginia (Local 358), and Naperville, Illinois (Local 1), plus distribution centers in Aurora, Colorado (Local 26) and Addison, Illinois.
items.caveats: The Fair Lawn, New Jersey and Atlanta, Georgia bakeries closed in 2021, cutting more than 1,000 union jobs. The Chicago bakery was downsized in 2016 when some lines moved to Salinas, Mexico, so check the package for a 'Made in Mexico' label on Oreo or Chips Ahoy. A 2021 strike ended with a four-year contract.

items.name: Frito-Lay (Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Fritos, Tostitos, Rold Gold, SunChips)
items.what: Lay's, Doritos, Cheetos, Fritos, Tostitos, Rold Gold, and SunChips come from union plants including Topeka, Kansas (BCTGM Local 218) and Vancouver, Washington (BCTGM), with Teamsters at many distribution centers.
items.caveats: Only a small share of Frito-Lay's roughly 30 US plants are union, including Topeka, Vancouver, and Kirkwood, New York. Topeka workers struck in 2021 over forced overtime. Products from non-union plants carry the exact same label, so you can't tell the difference at the store.

items.name: Cheez-It / Keebler crackers / Club / Town House (Kellanova)
items.what: Cheez-It, Keebler crackers, Club, and Town House come from cracker bakeries owned by Kellanova, formerly part of Kellogg, staffed by BCTGM members.
items.caveats: Kellanova was bought by Mars, with the deal closing December 11, 2025, so you may see it referred to as Kellanova/Mars going forward. BCTGM's own list still shows this as 'Kellogg Company Keebler Crackers,' and Keebler cookies like Fudge Stripes and Chips Deluxe are now made by Ferrero, also under a BCTGM contract per BCTGM's list. We don't have plant-level detail, and not every Kellanova bakery is union, including some former Keebler plants.

items.name: Snyder of Berlin
items.what: Snyder of Berlin chips and pretzels are made in Berlin, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: Don't confuse this with Snyder's of Hanover, which is owned by Campbell Snacks and is a completely different, non-union company.

items.name: Hershey (Hershey's bars, Kisses, Reese's, Kit Kat, Rolo, Jolly Rancher, Payday)
items.what: Hershey's bars, Kisses, Reese's, Kit Kat, Rolo, Jolly Rancher, and Payday are made at Hershey, Pennsylvania plants (the West Hershey plant and the Reese's plant), where workers belong to BCTGM Local 464, nicknamed the Chocolate Workers, plus a Hazleton, Pennsylvania plant that makes Jolly Rancher and Kit Kat.
items.caveats: Some Hershey products, including York and some Kisses and Twizzlers varieties, are made in Monterrey, Mexico, or at the non-union Robinson, Illinois and Stuarts Draft, Virginia plants. Check the package for 'Made in USA' and the plant location. Brookside, made in Canada, is also BCTGM.

items.name: Jelly Belly
items.what: Jelly Belly jelly beans are made in Fairfield, California, where workers belong to BCTGM Local 125, and also in North Chicago, Illinois.
items.caveats: A plant in Thailand supplies export markets outside the US.

items.name: Tootsie Roll Industries (Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Pops, Junior Mints, Sugar Daddy, Sugar Babies, Charleston Chew, Dots, Andes)
items.what: Tootsie Roll, Tootsie Pops, Junior Mints, Sugar Daddy, Sugar Babies, Charleston Chew, Dots, and Andes are made in Chicago, Illinois, where workers belong to BCTGM Local 1, and Junior Mints also come from a plant in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Concord Confections, in Canada, is part of the same company.

items.name: Just Born (Peeps, Mike and Ike, Hot Tamales, Zours)
items.what: Peeps, Mike and Ike, Hot Tamales, and Zours are made in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.
items.caveats: Workers there struck in 2016, and new hires since then have been excluded from the pension plan.

items.name: See's Candies
items.what: See's Candies are made in kitchens in South San Francisco and Los Angeles, California.

items.name: Ghirardelli
items.what: Ghirardelli chocolate is made in San Leandro, California.

items.name: Ferrara Candy (Butterfinger, Baby Ruth, 100 Grand, Raisinets, Crunch, Nerds, SweeTarts, Laffy Taffy, Brach's)
items.what: Butterfinger, Baby Ruth, 100 Grand, Raisinets, and Crunch come from Ferrara Candy plants in Franklin Park and Bellwood, Illinois, and Laffy Taffy and SweeTarts, Nerds, and Brach's are part of the same company's broader portfolio.
items.caveats: The union locals sometimes cited for these plants, like IBT 200 out of Milwaukee and IBT 26 out of Massachusetts, don't match up with the Chicago-area plants, so treat that attribution with caution. The Franklin Park and Bellwood plant assignments aren't well documented either. Ferrara's older Forest Park, Illinois plant is still running on a lease through 2031 but its union status is unclear, and a new Orangeburg, South Carolina plant is unlikely to be union. Brach's is now made in Mexico, and its old Chicago plant closed back in 2004, so Brach's itself is not union-made.

items.name: PEZ Candy
items.what: PEZ Candy is made in Orange, Connecticut.
items.caveats: The plastic dispensers themselves are made abroad.

items.name: Spangler (Dum Dums, Circus Peanuts, Sweethearts)
items.what: Dum Dums, Circus Peanuts, and Sweethearts are made in Bryan, Ohio.

items.name: Butterball
items.what: Butterball turkey and turkey products come from union plants represented by UFCW and Teamsters.
items.caveats: Butterball's largest plant, in Mount Olive, North Carolina, is not union. Union status varies a lot from plant to plant, so check before assuming.

items.name: Tyson Foods (fresh chicken, beef, pork; Hillshire Farm, Ball Park, Jimmy Dean)
items.what: Tyson fresh chicken, beef, and pork, along with Hillshire Farm, Ball Park, and Jimmy Dean, come from UFCW-represented plants including Dakota City, Nebraska (UFCW 222, beef), Waterloo, Iowa (UFCW 431, pork), Amarillo, Texas (UFCW 540), and Storm Lake, Iowa.
items.union: UFCW (various locals) / RWDSU at some poultry plants
items.caveats: Tyson has been closing plants fast. The Lexington, Nebraska beef plant closed in January 2026, cutting about 3,200 jobs, and the Joslin, Illinois beef plant, represented by UFCW Local 1546, closed August 13, 2026, cutting about 2,500 jobs, so neither is a union plant anymore. Tyson also closed its Eagle Mountain, Utah plant in August 2026 and put the Pasco, Washington plant up for sale. Most Southern poultry plants, including Springdale, Arkansas, are not union, and several other plants closed in 2023 and 2024, including Van Buren, Arkansas, Glen Allen, Virginia, and the Perry, Iowa pork plant. Given how fast this is changing, check the plant code printed on the package.

items.name: Hormel (Spam, Hormel bacon, chili, Dinty Moore, Skippy, Planters)
items.what: Spam, Hormel bacon and chili, Dinty Moore, Skippy, and Planters come from plants in Austin, Minnesota, represented by UFCW 663, plus Algona, Iowa, Fremont, Nebraska (UFCW 293), Beloit, Wisconsin, and Atlanta, Georgia.
items.caveats: Applegate and some other acquired brands are made by outside co-packers, and Jennie-O's plants have mixed union status.

items.name: Smithfield Foods (Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan's Famous, Armour)
items.what: Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan's Famous, and Armour products come from plants including Tar Heel, North Carolina (UFCW 1208), Sioux Falls, South Dakota (UFCW 304A), and Smithfield, Virginia (UFCW 400).
items.caveats: Not every Smithfield plant is union. The company is owned by China's WH Group.

items.name: JBS USA / Swift ground beef
items.what: Swift ground beef comes from JBS USA plants including Greeley, Colorado (UFCW 7), Marshalltown, Iowa (UFCW 1149), Worthington, Minnesota (UFCW 663), and Indiana (UFCW 700).
items.caveats: About 3,800 Greeley, Colorado workers struck for around three weeks in March and April 2026. A new contract was ratified in April 2026 and runs through 2028.

items.name: Cargill Meat Solutions (Cargill, Excel ground beef)
items.what: Cargill and Excel ground beef come from plants in Dodge City, Kansas (UFCW 2), Schuyler, Nebraska (UFCW 293), and Fort Morgan, Colorado (UFCW 7).
items.caveats: Cargill locked out Fort Morgan, Colorado workers starting May 20, 2026. A five-year contract was ratified August 17, 2026 by a vote of 1,113 to 211, and the plant was back to full operation by September 3, 2026.

items.name: National Beef
items.what: National Beef products come from plants in Dodge City and Liberal, Kansas.

items.name: Boar's Head
items.what: Boar's Head deli meats and cheeses appear on union shopping lists, but the one plant with a confirmed union contract, Jarratt, Virginia, represented by UFCW Local 400, closed for good in September 2024 after a listeria outbreak.
items.caveats: No other Boar's Head plant, including Holland, Michigan, Forrest City, Arkansas, Sarasota, Florida, New Castle, Indiana, or Petersburg, Virginia, has a confirmed union contract, and the NLRB (National Labor Relations Board) found against the company in a case about discouraging unionizing. Don't assume a given package is union-made.

items.name: Koegel Meats
items.what: Koegel's Viennas and bologna are made in Flint, Michigan.

items.name: Oscar Mayer (Kraft Heinz)
items.what: Oscar Mayer products from Kraft Heinz are made in Davenport, Iowa, where workers belong to UFCW Local 431, which even runs its own page for the Davenport plant.
items.caveats: Some Oscar Mayer items are made elsewhere by outside co-packers. The old Madison, Wisconsin plant, which was UFCW 538, closed back in 2017.

items.name: Land O'Lakes
items.what: Land O'Lakes butter and cheese plants are represented by Teamsters, and its milling operations by BCTGM.
items.caveats: This varies by plant, and some Land O'Lakes plants aren't union at all.

items.name: Tillamook County Creamery Association
items.what: Tillamook cheese is made at the Tillamook County Creamery Association plant in Tillamook, Oregon, where about 250 production workers voted 111 to 91 in December 2022 to keep Teamsters Local 58, and ratified a new contract in May 2023.
items.caveats: Maintenance techs at the Tillamook plant decertified their union in 2018. The Boardman, Oregon plant, which makes ice cream, is not union.

items.name: Dannon (Danone)
items.what: Dannon yogurt is made at the Danone plant in Minster, Ohio, and other Dannon plants.

items.name: Kraft Heinz (Kraft cheese, Velveeta, Cheez Whiz, Heinz ketchup, Ore-Ida, Miracle Whip, A1, Grey Poupon, Claussen)
items.what: Kraft cheese, Velveeta, Cheez Whiz, Heinz ketchup, Ore-Ida, Miracle Whip, A1, Grey Poupon, and Claussen come from several plants: Heinz ketchup from Fremont, Ohio, Ore-Ida from Ontario, Oregon (UFCW and Teamsters), Claussen from Woodstock, Illinois (UFCW), and Kraft cheese from Springfield, Missouri (UFCW) and Champaign, Illinois.
items.caveats: Union status is plant by plant, and Kraft Heinz has closed several plants between 2015 and 2025.

items.name: Campbell's (Campbell's soup, Prego, Pace, Swanson)
items.what: Campbell's soup, Prego, Pace, and Swanson come from plants in Napoleon, Ohio, Paris, Texas, and Maxton, North Carolina.
items.caveats: Only Napoleon, Ohio is confirmed union, represented by UFCW Local 75. We couldn't find a union source for the Maxton, North Carolina or Paris, Texas plants, both of which are in right-to-work states and are being expanded, so treat those as unconfirmed. Campbell Snacks brands like Pepperidge Farm and Snyder's-Lance don't appear on any union list.

items.name: Bimbo Bakeries USA (Arnold, Oroweat, Stroehmann, Freihofer's, Thomas', Sara Lee bread, Entenmann's, Ball Park buns)
items.what: Arnold, Oroweat, Stroehmann, Freihofer's, Thomas', Sara Lee bread, Entenmann's, and Ball Park buns come from Bimbo Bakeries USA plants, where BCTGM represents bakery workers and Teamsters represent drivers.
items.caveats: This varies by plant, and a number of Bimbo Bakeries USA locations aren't union.

items.name: Tastykake (Flowers Foods)
items.what: Tastykake, a Flowers Foods brand, is made at the Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Navy Yard bakery.
items.caveats: Other Flowers Foods brands, like Nature's Own, Wonder, and Dave's Killer Bread, are mostly non-union.

items.name: Aunt Millie's
items.what: Aunt Millie's bread comes from a bakery in Fort Wayne, Indiana and other Midwest bakeries.

items.name: Kellogg's cereal (Frosted Flakes, Froot Loops, Rice Krispies, Raisin Bran, WK Kellogg Co)
items.what: Frosted Flakes, Froot Loops, Rice Krispies, and Raisin Bran, made by WK Kellogg Co, come from bakeries in Battle Creek, Michigan (BCTGM Local 3G), Lancaster, Pennsylvania (Local 374G), and Memphis, Tennessee (Local 252G).
items.caveats: The Omaha, Nebraska plant, which was BCTGM Local 50G, closed for good in August 2026, cutting 451 jobs, so it's no longer part of this list. Workers there struck for 77 days back in 2021. Ferrero completed its purchase of WK Kellogg in September 2025, so watch for more consolidation. Boxes from the remaining union plants are stamped 'Union Made.'

items.name: General Mills cereal (Cheerios, Wheaties, Lucky Charms, Chex)
items.what: Cheerios, Wheaties, Lucky Charms, and Chex come from plants in Buffalo, New York (BCTGM Local 36G, where Cheerios is made), Cedar Rapids, Iowa (BCTGM Local 100G), and Kansas City among other locations.
items.caveats: This varies by plant.

items.name: Quaker Oats (PepsiCo)
items.what: Quaker Oats, a PepsiCo brand, is made in Cedar Rapids, Iowa (RWDSU, the Retail, Wholesale and Department Store Union, Local 110) and Danville, Illinois (BCTGM).

items.name: Folgers (J.M. Smucker)
items.what: Folgers coffee, made by J.M. Smucker, is roasted in New Orleans, Louisiana.
items.caveats: The only source calling this a union plant is Labor 411, which lists it as UAW (United Auto Workers) made, but we couldn't find a UAW local, contract, or NLRB record confirming that. Labor 411's union attributions aren't always reliable at that level of detail, so treat this as possibly union until a better source turns up.

items.name: Maxwell House (Kraft Heinz)
items.what: Maxwell House, made by Kraft Heinz, is roasted at a plant in Jacksonville, Florida, which Kraft Heinz has been investing in and upgrading through 2025 and 2026.
items.caveats: It's named on UFCW's August 2026 Labor Day shopping list and on Labor 411, but we couldn't find the specific local number, and the claim that it's UFCW, UAW, and Teamsters all together comes only from Labor 411.

items.name: American Crystal Sugar / Crystal Sugar
items.what: American Crystal Sugar and Crystal Sugar come from beet processing plants in the Red River Valley of Minnesota and North Dakota.
items.caveats: The company locked out workers from 2011 to 2013.

items.name: Dole (canned pineapple, packaged salads) / Fresh Express
items.what: Dole canned pineapple and packaged foods, along with Fresh Express packaged salads, are handled by Teamsters.
items.caveats: This varies by plant and warehouse.

items.name: Andy Boy / D'Arrigo Bros. produce
items.what: Andy Boy broccoli, cauliflower, and romaine, grown by D'Arrigo Bros. in Salinas, California, are picked under a UFW (United Farm Workers) contract.

items.name: GE Appliances (Haier) - Appliance Park, Louisville
items.what: GE, GE Profile, Cafe, Monogram, and Hotpoint top-load washers and matching dryers, dishwashers, and bottom-freezer and side-by-side refrigerators are built at Appliance Park in Louisville, Kentucky, where about 5,200 hourly workers are employed. Check the serial or rating plate for Louisville as the origin.
items.caveats: Only the Louisville-built lines are union. GE Appliances' other plants, in Decatur, Alabama (top-freezer fridges), LaFayette, Georgia, Selmer, Tennessee, and Camden, South Carolina, are not represented, and a lot of GE-branded product is imported from Haier's operations in China, plus Mexico and Korea. A new contract was ratified in January 2025 after members first voted down a deal in December 2024.

items.name: Bradford White water heaters
items.what: Bradford White residential and commercial gas, electric, and AeroTherm heat-pump water heaters are built in Middleville, Michigan, with a workforce of roughly 1,200 to 1,600. The steel tanks come from Niles Steel Tank in Niles, Michigan.
items.union: UAW Local 1002 (Middleville); USW Local 13729 (Niles Steel Tank)
items.caveats: These are sold through plumbing wholesalers and contractors, not big-box stores. The Laars division in Rochester, New Hampshire, and the Bock division in Wisconsin, acquired in 2025, aren't confirmed as union.

items.name: Whirlpool / Maytag / KitchenAid / Amana refrigerators - Amana, Iowa
items.what: Whirlpool, Maytag, KitchenAid, and Amana side-by-side and bottom-freezer refrigerators are built at the Amana, Iowa refrigeration plant, where workers belong to IAM Local 1526.
items.caveats: The plant has been shrinking fast: about 250 jobs were cut in 2025, then about 400 more on March 9, 2026, as the French-door refrigerator line moved to plants in Ramos Arizpe and Celaya, Mexico. The workforce went from about 3,000 to about 1,500 over 2025 and 2026. Amana still builds side-by-side and bottom-freezer units, so check the rating plate for 'Amana, IA.' Whirlpool's other US plants, covered in a separate entry, have no confirmed union.

items.name: Whirlpool Ohio/Oklahoma/Tennessee plants (Clyde washers, Marion dryers, Findlay dishwashers, Ottawa freezers, Tulsa ranges, Cleveland TN cooking)
items.what: Whirlpool, Maytag, KitchenAid, and Amana washers from Clyde, Ohio, dryers from Marion, Ohio, dishwashers from Findlay, Ohio, chest freezers and built-in refrigeration from Ottawa, Ohio, ranges from Tulsa, Oklahoma, and KitchenAid and JennAir cooking products from Cleveland, Tennessee are all made in the US. The company announced a $300 million laundry expansion in 2025.
items.union: Union status at these plants NOT confirmed by any union source (historic IUE-CWA presence at Evansville IN and St. Cloud MN plants ended when those closed)
items.caveats: We could not find any union source, current or past, naming a union at any of these plants. Treat them as made in the US but with union status unknown, and likely non-union. UAW Local 997 does represent Whirlpool's replacement-parts operation, which is a separate entry.

items.name: Whirlpool replacement parts (UAW-handled)
items.what: Whirlpool Corporation's replacement and service parts are handled by UAW Local 997 Unit 4, part of UAW Region 4, according to the UAW's product guide.
items.caveats: This covers parts distribution and packaging, not building the appliances themselves. The guide is dated June 2019, so treat it as dated.

items.name: Speed Queen washers and dryers (Alliance Laundry Systems)
items.what: Speed Queen residential and commercial washers and dryers, along with the Huebsch and UniMac commercial brands, are built at Alliance Laundry Systems' plant in Ripon, Wisconsin, where workers belong to USW (United Steelworkers) Local 1327. Alliance's own press release announced a five-year agreement running from January 1, 2022 through the end of 2026, covering about 1,750 hourly workers at both Ripon and Manitowoc, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: That contract expires at the end of 2026, so watch for renewal news. Some Speed Queen products are actually built at Alliance plants overseas, in Belgium, Czechia, and China, so check for Ripon as the place of origin.

items.name: Sub-Zero refrigeration / Wolf cooking - Madison & Fitchburg, WI
items.what: Sub-Zero built-in refrigerators are made in Madison, Wisconsin and Wolf ranges and ovens in Fitchburg, Wisconsin, both built by members of SMART (International Association of Sheet Metal, Air, Rail and Transportation Workers).
items.union: SMART (Sheet Metal, Air, Rail and Transportation Workers) - Madison-area local
items.caveats: The union relationship is best documented from 2010 to 2016, covering a 2010 contract fight and a 2016 Department of Energy meeting, so confirm the current contract before relying on it. Sub-Zero's newer plants in Goodyear and Phoenix, Arizona, Richmond, Kentucky, and Cedar Rapids, Iowa are not known to be union, and Cove dishwashers and some other products are made in Arizona.

items.name: Lennox residential furnaces and air conditioners - Marshalltown, Iowa
items.what: Lennox residential furnaces, air conditioners, and heat pumps are built in Marshalltown, Iowa by members of UAW Local 893 Unit 11.
items.caveats: Lennox also builds in Saltillo, Mexico and Stuttgart, Arkansas, neither of which is union. Marshalltown employment was around 900 before layoffs hit in 2023 through 2025. Ask your dealer whether the unit was built in Marshalltown.

brand: lennox residential furnaces and air conditioners

items.name: Carrier / Bryant gas furnaces - Indianapolis
items.what: Carrier and Bryant residential gas furnaces are built at the Indianapolis, Indiana plant, where members of USW Local 1999 hold roughly 700 to 1,100 jobs after a partial move to Monterrey, Mexico between 2016 and 2018.
items.caveats: This covers furnaces only. Carrier air conditioners and heat pumps are built in Collierville, Tennessee and in Mexico, neither of which is union. Headcount at the Indianapolis plant has shrunk repeatedly since 2017, so confirm the plant is still making your specific model.

items.name: Trane commercial HVAC - Clarksville, Tennessee
items.what: Trane commercial rooftop units and chillers are built in Clarksville, Tennessee by about 1,100 members of IAM, who ratified a four-year contract in February 2025.
items.caveats: This is commercial equipment only. Trane and American Standard residential units are built in Tyler, Texas, Trenton, New Jersey, Vidalia, Georgia, and Mexico, and we could not confirm the union status of those plants.

items.name: All-Clad cookware
items.what: All-Clad bonded stainless, copper, and aluminum cookware, including the D3, D5, Copper Core, and G5 lines, is made in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania by about 125 members of USW. Roughly 90 percent of All-Clad cookware comes from Canonsburg.
items.caveats: Nonstick 'HA1' pieces, bakeware, tools, lids, and some accessories are imported from China. Look for a 'Made in USA' stamp on the pan itself.

items.name: Vollrath cookware and kitchen supplies
items.what: Vollrath metal pans, stainless cookware, and restaurant and kitchen supplies are made in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: Vollrath also has plants in River Falls, Wisconsin, Ohio, and overseas. The UAW guide covers the Sheboygan operation specifically. Most of what Vollrath makes goes through the foodservice channel, not retail.

items.name: Regal Ware cookware (Regal, Saladmaster, Royal Prestige, American Kitchen)
items.what: Regal, Saladmaster, Royal Prestige, and American Kitchen stainless steel and cast aluminum pots and pans are made in West Bend and Kewaskum, Wisconsin.
items.caveats: The Wisconsin AFL-CIO lists Regal Ware as USW-made but we couldn't find a local number. Much of what Regal Ware makes is sold through direct-sales brands like Saladmaster and Royal Prestige, with American Kitchen as its retail line.
